en: Tell my daughter I found the bottom.
zh: 告訴我女兒，我找到井底了。

en: There were stairs. There were stairs.
zh: 這裡本來有樓梯的。本來有的。

en: The Order lied. I would have come anyway.
zh: 騎士團說了謊。但我還是會來。

en: I was sent to be a wall. I should have liked to be a person.
zh: 他們派我來當一道牆。我其實比較想當一個人。

en: It struck me with my own stroke.
zh: 它用我自己的招式打我。

en: I am the fourth to write upon this page. There is no more room.
zh: 我是第四個在這一頁寫字的人。已經沒有地方可以寫了。

en: There is a woman in there. I heard her breathing.
zh: 它裡面有一個女人。我聽見她在呼吸。

en: Mind the sky when it falleth.
zh: 天塌下來的時候，看好頭頂。

en: Whoever readeth this: the shield breaketh first.
zh: 讀到這一頁的人：盾會先碎。

en: Go home, if it let thee. Someone ought to.
zh: 如果它放你走，就回家吧。總該有人回家。
